messages:
aisha: Heads up — canary for SHIP-827 (adaptive batch handoff) is showing a decode p95 spike on text-gen routes, started ~10:12 UTC.

matt: saw that, p95 up ~28% on canary vs baseline. CI perf check failed on e2e-decode. perf-bot posted flamegraphs.

diego: looked at live traces, frequent kernel handoffs + KV evictions. Looks like the new handoff timer is racing with prefix cache eviction.

perf-bot: CI perf regression detected: e2e-decode p95 +30%. Flamegraph: https://perf.company/internal/fg/2141

olivia: bisect started, isolating commit range. initial suspect: runtime.adaptive_batch change and scheduler/hand-off reorder.

matt: quick profiler dump:
```
kv_cache_evictions_per_sec: 210
average_batch_size: 1.9 -> oscillating 1..8
decode_tokens/sec: -18%
```

diego: bisect result points to commit b6f7a2d — changeset 'scheduler: prefer immediate handoff for pending batches'. When reverted locally, p95 returns to baseline.

aisha: can we toggle the flag on canary? runtime.adaptive_batch.enabled=false to stop adaptive handoff and see.

olivia: toggled on canary, metrics dropping: kv_evictions/s -> 6, p95 back within 2%.

matt: rollout blocked until we decide revert vs patch. Suggest hotfix: constrain handoff to not preempt KV cache window (add 50ms backoff), and revert the aggressive scheduler change in the short term.

diego: I'll open a PR with the backoff + unit tests and plan cherry-pick. If urgent, we can revert b6f7a2d from main and redeploy canary.

aisha: assign diego to fix, olivia to coordinate canary rollback if needed. tagging @sre-oncall for deployment window.

sre-oncall: noted, can prepare rollback bucket and standby nodes, will coordinate a 15m maintenance if we revert.

matt: summary: blocker on canary -> flip flag to disable adaptive handed-off, patch + cherry-pick, or revert commit. Next: diego to PR, olivia to monitor canary, matt to approve revert if PR too slow. :thumbsup:
